title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber I Cap. 8 densify complete)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber I Cap. 8 De sacrae Scripturae efficacia COMPLETE (PHYS mid-276–mid-290 before Cap. 8).
blurb: Ludwig Crocius — Book I Chapter 8 On Sacred Scripture's efficacy, from the 1636 Bremen Latin. Densify COMPLETE (PHYS mid-276–mid-290): efficacy defined as Scripture's property of illuminating and vivifying by the Spirit's elevated instrument; differs from mere perspicuity; objective and effective efficacy; letter alone does not convert; prior grace-light required; Scripture reading for all; against papal vernacular bans, intermittent reading, laity bans, and hanging-Scripture superstition. Cap. 8 On Scripture's efficacy begins mid PHYS 276; Cap. 6 complete; the rest of the Syntagma remains.
era_note: Crocius wrote in the early seventeenth century as Reformed professor at the illustrious school of Bremen. This is not a patristic work. It is a public-domain Latin Reformed retrieval on the same Fathers-site pipeline. The 1636 Villerian folio is Public Domain Mark 1.0. Do not treat the site as ante-Nicene only.
first_english_note: No complete public-domain English of this 1636 Latin Syntagma was locked as reading text. This is a new rendering from locked Latin for Liber I Cap. 8 densify complete.

text_history.method: English follows the locked 1636 Bremen Latin of Liber I Cap. 8 densify COMPLETE, reconstructed from SLUB Dresden page images (PHYS mid-276–mid-290 before CAPUT NONUM). Same-page OCR (tesseract lat + Vision) used as check. No modern English was copied. Cap. 9 (CAPUT NONUM / De sacrae Scripturae partibus) begins PHYS 290. No Internet Archive copy was located.
